contract.name: Timeout Acceptance Contract
contract.description: 定义 Deadline 到期时的竞争关系与终态接受规则

raceScenarios.determination: Execution Pipeline 观察到 ctx.Err() == DeadlineExceeded

raceScenarios.resolution: 若终态已提交（Success），后续 Timeout 不得覆盖
raceScenarios.rule: terminal state linearization — first commit wins

raceScenarios.resolution: 谁先被终态接受系统处理谁赢

acceptancePoints.pipeline: TimeoutCtrl.WithTimeout 创建 context 后，runtime 在 select 中观察 Done channel
acceptancePoints.adapter: adapter_android/ios/desktop handleCtxError 检测 DeadlineExceeded 并映射为 StatusTimedOut
acceptancePoints.result: 最终写入 UnifiedToolResult.Status = timed_out + ErrorCodeTimeout
